caption: The drawing features two distinct objects: near the top, there is a faint, lightly sketched outline of a vessel or jug with a single handle, narrow neck, and rounded body; this outline is done in a light pencil with no color filling. Below it, occupying the center of the composition, there is a rectangular area filled with a light brown wash. Inside this rectangle, there is a stylized depiction of a bird, which faces to the left with its head raised. The bird is rendered in shades of gray, and it has multiple black spots along its body and a dark outline emphasizing its contour. The background outside the brown rectangle remains uncolored with the natural off-white tone of the paper. There are some faint pencil inscriptions near the bottom and top right corners of the image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
